notes.title: A very short changelog
notes.content: - We gave Kaiju his glasses back (Fixed very blurry vision bug)

notes.title: Halloween update
notes.content:
Hello fellow city destroyers! We have a Halloween related special for you to experience. 
New spooky map with Haunted House to destroy. Have fun demolishing it.
We would also like to announce a discount pack including both of our recent games for some festive marathon - KAIJU MONSTER VR and Jousting VR.

notes.title: Minor update from 10/26/2022
notes.content:
We've made some minor fixes and made preparations for the upcoming major updates.
The next one is scheduled for 10/28/2022

notes.title: Get ready for the action
notes.content:
The time has finally come! 
Are you ready to destroy some cities? It can be therapeutic! Enter the game and smash some skyscrapers. Watch out for all of those military units though.

We care deeply about our games and we are constantly working on making them the best experience possible. Therefore your feedback is really important and highly appreciated.

notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.content:
The new and updated demo is out now for all of you destruction lovers waiting out there!
We've changed the SDK to OpenXR so now the game works identically on all listed headsets.
